responsibility: Builds the generated `specs-*` files for AVR core architectures and concrete devices from the canonical MCU tables. This host utility includes the AVR device database and target spec fragments, then emits one specs file per architecture/device encoding AVR-LibC startup/device-library selections, cc1 defaults such as flash count, RMW, errata-skip, absdata, assembler options, linker relax/architecture settings, section start addresses, short-call and stack-pointer defaults, and device-specific CPP macros, making it the generator that materializes per-`-mmcu` driver behavior from the declarative AVR descriptions.
